title: Kati Hermann — one fat word as the whole header, ruled list nav under it
note: The page opens on "Kati" set in a heavy, wide, rounded grotesk (a Readymag custom upload, about 300px, black on white) running edge to edge. Under it the project list is plain: Posters, Editorial, ShortFilm, Book, VisualId, each a 12px mono label centred in its own row between 1px light-grey (#D6D6D6) rules. Above the word, a mono ticker crawls across the top in a 25s CSS animation: "*Currently based in Berlin* // [ Contact: | email ] //", with the address in default link blue. Built in Readymag, no WebGL. Worth reusing: let one short name do the branding at full width, and keep the nav as quiet as a table of contents.
